title: Webhook Delivery Contract
content:
Purpose: Webhook Delivery Contract.

Technical details: Webhook events contain event_id, event_type, created_at, and payload. Consumers should acknowledge successful receipt with HTTP 2xx and process repeated event_id values idempotently.

Operational guidance: Retries can deliver duplicate events. Use event identifiers and processing records to prevent duplicate side effects.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
